viewToggle = {

  const mo = document.querySelector(".month-options-container")
  if (wk) wk.style.display = (defaultView === "week") ? "block" : "none"
  if (mo) mo.style.display = (defaultView === "month") ? "block" : "none"

```{ojs}
normalizeSep = (raw) => (raw == null ? "\\t" : raw).replace(/\\t/g, "\t").replace(/\\n/g, "\n").replace(/\\\\/g, "\\")
```

```{ojs}
splitNames = (txt, fallback) => {
  const values = (txt || "").split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  return values.length ? values : fallback
}
```

```{ojs}
escapeHtml = (value) => {
  const replacements = {"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"}
  return String(value == null ? "" : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => replacements[character])
}
```

```{ojs}
detailItemIcons = ({
  location: "toastui-calendar-ic-location-b",
  recurrenceRule: "toastui-calendar-ic-repeat-b",
  attendees: "toastui-calendar-ic-user-b",
  state: "toastui-calendar-ic-state-b",
  calendar: "toastui-calendar-calendar-dot"
})
```

```{ojs}
nativeDetailItems = new Set(nativeDetailItemNames)
```

```{ojs}
eventDetailValue = (event, item, calendars) => {
  if (item === "calendar") {
    const calendar = calendars.find((candidate) => candidate.id === event.calendarId)
    return calendar ? calendar.name || "" : ""
  }
  let value = event[item]
  if (value == null && event.raw) value = event.raw[item]
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.join(", ")
  return value == null ? "" : value
}
```

```{ojs}
renderEventDetails = (event, items, calendars) => {
  const details = items.map((item) => {
    const value = eventDetailValue(event, item, calendars)
    if (value === "") return ""
    const iconClass = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(detailItemIcons, item) ? detailItemIcons[item] : ""
    const iconStyle = item === "calendar" && event.backgroundColor ? ` style="background-color:${escapeHtml(event.backgroundColor)}"` : ""
    const icon = iconClass ? `<span class="toastui-calendar-icon toastui-calendar-event-detail-icon ${iconClass}"${iconStyle}></span>` : ""
    const label = nativeDetailItems.has(item) ? "" : `<strong>${escapeHtml(item)}:</strong> `
    return `<span class="toastui-calendar-event-detail-item">${icon}${label}${escapeHtml(value)}</span>`
  }).join("")
  return details ? `<span class="toastui-calendar-event-detail-items">${details}</span>` : ""
}
```

```{ojs}
renderCustomPopupDetails = (container, event, items, calendars) => {
  const customItems = items.filter((item) => !nativeDetailItems.has(item))
  if (!customItems.length) return true

  const section = container.querySelector(".toastui-calendar-section-detail")
  if (!section) return false
  section.querySelectorAll(".toastui-calendar-custom-detail-item").forEach((element) => element.remove())
  customItems.forEach((item) => {
    const value = eventDetailValue(event, item, calendars)
    if (value === "") return
    const row = document.createElement("div")
    row.className = "toastui-calendar-detail-item toastui-calendar-custom-detail-item"
    const label = document.createElement("strong")
    label.textContent = item + ": "
    row.append(label, document.createTextNode(String(value)))
    section.append(row)
  })
  return true
}
```

```{ojs}
formatEventTime = (value) => `${String(value.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(value.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`
```

```{ojs}
parseDelimited = (text, sep) => {
  const lines = (text || "").split(/\r?\n/).filter((line) => line.trim() !== "")
  if (lines.length < 2) return []
  const headers = lines[0].split(sep)
  return lines.slice(1).map((line) => {
    const values = line.split(sep)
    const row = {}
    headers.forEach((h, j) => {
      const key = (h || "").trim()
      const raw = (values[j] || "").trim()
      if (!key) return
      if (raw === "true") row[key] = true
      else if (raw === "false") row[key] = false
      else row[key] = raw
    })
    return row
  })
}
```

```{ojs}
loadFileEvents = async (path, sep) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(path)
    if (!response.ok) return {events: [], error: "Could not load " + path + " (" + response.status + ")"}
    const text = await response.text()
    return {events: parseDelimited(text, sep), error: ""}
  } catch (err) {
    return {events: [], error: "Could not load " + path}
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
autoDate = {
  const starts = eventList
    .map((e) => e.start || "")
    .filter((s) => s.length >= 10)
    .sort()
  if (starts.length) return starts[0].slice(0, 10)
  return "2026-04-13"
}
```

```{ojs}
calendarConfig = ({
  defaultView: defaultView,
  isReadOnly: isReadOnly,
  usageStatistics: false,
  gridSelection: true,
  useDetailPopup: useDetailPopup,
  week: {
    startDayOfWeek: weekStartDay,
    dayNames: splitNames(weekDayNames, ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]),
    narrowWeekend: weekNarrowWeekend,
    workweek: weekWorkweek,
    showNowIndicator: weekShowNowIndicator,
    hourStart: weekHourStart,
    hourEnd: weekHourEnd,
    eventView: weekEventView.length ? weekEventView : false,
    taskView: weekTaskView.length ? weekTaskView : false
  },
  month: {
    startDayOfWeek: monthStartDay,
    dayNames: splitNames(monthDayNames, ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]),
    narrowWeekend: monthNarrowWeekend,
    workweek: monthWorkweek,
    visibleWeeksCount: monthVisibleWeeksCount,
    isAlways6Weeks: monthAlways6Weeks
  },
  timezone: {
    zones: [{
      timezoneName: "Europe/Stockholm",
      timezoneOffset: 1,
      displayLabel: "Stockholm"
    }]
  },
  calendars: calendarDefinitions,
  template: {
    time: (event) => {
      const title = escapeHtml(event.title)
      const titleAndTime = event.start ? `<strong>${formatEventTime(event.start)}</strong>&nbsp;${title}` : title
      return titleAndTime + renderEventDetails(event, eventDetailItems, calendarDefinitions)
    }
  }
})
```

```{ojs}
calendar = {
  const mount = document.querySelector("#calendar-mount")
  const preview = document.querySelector("#config-preview")
  const toYAML = (value, level = 0) => {
    const indent = "  ".repeat(level)
    if (value == null) return "null"
    if (typeof value === "string") {
      if (value === "") return "''"
      return "'" + value.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"
    }
    if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") return String(value)
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (!value.length) return "[]"
      return value.map((item) => {
        if (item && typeof item === "object") {
          const block = toYAML(item, level + 1)
          const lines = block.split("\n")
          return indent + "- " + lines[0] + (lines.length > 1 ? "\n" + lines.slice(1).map((line) => indent + "  " + line).join("\n") : "")
        }
        return indent + "- " + toYAML(item, level + 1)
      }).join("\n")
    }
    const entries = Object.entries(value).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined)
    if (!entries.length) return "{}"
    return entries.map(([key, val]) => {
      if (val && typeof val === "object") {
        return indent + key + ":\n" + toYAML(val, level + 1)
      }
      return indent + key + ": " + toYAML(val, level + 1)
    }).join("\n")
  }
  const {template, ...previewCalendarConfig} = calendarConfig
  const payload = {
    toastui: {
      calendar: previewCalendarConfig,
      extension: {
        height: heightPx + "px",
        file: filePath,
        "file-sep": fileSepRaw,
        date: initialDate,
        eventDetailItems: eventDetailItems,
        popupDetailItems: popupDetailItems
      },
      runtime: {
        eventsLoaded: eventList.length,
        eventError: eventError || null
      }
    }
  }
  if (preview) preview.textContent = toYAML(payload)
  if (!window.tui || !window.tui.Calendar) return null
  if (!mount) return null
  mount.style.height = heightPx + "px"
  const popupDetailClasses = {
    location: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-location",
    recurrenceRule: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-recurrence-rule",
    attendees: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-attendees",
    state: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-state",
    calendar: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-calendar",
    body: "toastui-calendar-detail-exclude-body"
  }
  mount.classList.toggle("toastui-calendar-detail-popup-enabled", useDetailPopup)
  Object.entries(popupDetailClasses).forEach(([item, className]) => {
    mount.classList.toggle(className, useDetailPopup && !popupDetailItems.includes(item))
  })
  const hasCustomPopupDetails = popupDetailItems.some((item) => !nativeDetailItems.has(item))
  mount.classList.toggle("toastui-calendar-detail-has-custom", useDetailPopup && hasCustomPopupDetails)
  if (window.__playgroundCal && typeof window.__playgroundCal.destroy === "function") {
    window.__playgroundCal.destroy()
  }
  mount.innerHTML = ""
  const cal = new window.tui.Calendar(mount, calendarConfig)
  window.__playgroundCal = cal
  if (useDetailPopup && hasCustomPopupDetails) {
    cal.on("clickEvent", (info) => {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (renderCustomPopupDetails(mount, info.event, popupDetailItems, calendarDefinitions)) observer.disconnect()
      })
      observer.observe(mount, {childList: true, subtree: true})
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        renderCustomPopupDetails(mount, info.event, popupDetailItems, calendarDefinitions)
        observer.disconnect()
      }, 100)
    })
  }
  const normalizedEvents = eventList.map((event, index) => {
    const normalized = {...event}
    if (normalized.id == null || normalized.id === "") normalized.id = `playground-event-${index}`
    normalized.raw = {...normalized, ...(normalized.raw && typeof normalized.raw === "object" ? normalized.raw : {})}
    if (!normalized.state) normalized.state = ""
    if (normalized.attendees != null && !Array.isArray(normalized.attendees)) normalized.attendees = [String(normalized.attendees)]
    if (!normalized.attendees || (Array.isArray(normalized.attendees) && normalized.attendees.length === 0)) normalized.attendees = null
    return normalized
  })
  if (normalizedEvents.length) cal.createEvents(normalizedEvents)
  if (initialDate) cal.setDate(new Date(initialDate))
  invalidation.then(() => { cal.destroy(); window.__playgroundCal = null })
  return cal
}
```
